# NextEdge Access Solutions (NEAS)

> Official website: https://www.nextedge-access-solutions.com/

NextEdge Access Solutions OPC (NEAS) is a Philippines-based provider of rope access, work-at-height, industrial maintenance, inspection, renewable-energy support, telecom and met-mast services, façade solutions, safety training, and PPE supply.

## Public website
- Homepage: https://www.nextedge-access-solutions.com/
- Online store: https://www.nextedge-access-solutions.com/store
- Privacy policy: https://www.nextedge-access-solutions.com/privacy-policy

## Main service areas
- Industrial rope access and work-at-height solutions
- Wind turbine and renewable-energy support services
- Telecom tower and meteorological mast services
- Industrial maintenance and inspection support
- Building façade access, cleaning and maintenance
- Working-at-height and rope-rescue training
- Personal protective equipment supply

## Geographic focus
The current public SEO campaign is focused on the Philippines. Contact NEAS directly to confirm service coverage, project availability, personnel credentials, and technical scope.
